Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <cs959651-070...@130.95.80.111>,

Peter Gordon WILSMORE <cs95...@cs.uwa.edu.au> wrote:
>In the jyhad rules about dogdes it says the following a dodge may be used
>in leiu of a strike does this mean that

No. It says a Dodge *might be thought of* as more in lieu of a strike, but it
is still a strike.

>I play my strike
>He/she plays a real nasty strike
>I play dodge?

No. You only get one choice for your strike; once made - you can't change it.
